description: Searches a bounded UTC range for the requested angular separation between exactly two selected bodies, then refines each detected crossing to the calculator minute. It uses a fixed, owner-operated ephemeris calculator with at most 48 samples and four concurrent requests. Geometry only: no prediction or interpretation. Price: $0.02 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

bodies.description: Exactly two distinct supported body names.

endUtc.description: UTC end time, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ; within seven days.

stepMinutes.description: Optional sampling interval from 60 to 1440 minutes; default 240. Range and step may not exceed 48 samples.

targetDegrees.description: Requested angular separation from 0 to 180 degrees.

name: celestial_event_window
title: Celestial angular event window
